question: There is a large cone with a diameter of 14m and height of 12m. It is being filled with water at a rate of 2 m3 in every 20 seconds. How long will it take to fill the cone?
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the cone = 14 m

Radius of the cone (r) = 7 m

Height of the cone (h) = 12 m

Rate of water filling = 2 m³ / 20 sec

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cone = (1)/(3) pi r² h

Time to fill the cone = Volume of the cone / Rate of water filling

**Calculation:**

Volume of the cone:

⇒ Volume = (1)/(3) pi × 7² × 12

⇒ Volume = (1)/(3) pi × 49 × 12

⇒ Volume = (1)/(3) pi × 588

⇒ Volume = 196π m³

Rate of water filling:

⇒ Rate = 2 m³ / 20 sec

⇒ Rate = 0.1 m³ / sec

Time to fill the cone:

⇒ Time = Volume / Rate

⇒ Time = 196π / 0.1

⇒ Time = 1960π sec

⇒ Time ≈ 6160 sec (using π ≈ 3.14)

**It will take approximately 6160 seconds to fill the cone.**
